description: Ratchet eval fixture: a page with enumerated callout kinds (next-phase plan section 2.3 item 2) and an evidence-gated pull quote. The model picks a kind from the enum and writes the body, or copies a quote verbatim from the sources; callout types, titles and the blockquote belong to the template.

pull_quote.role: verbatim line from a source, rendered as a blockquote

callouts.role: boxed aside flagging a risk or a tip

body.role: the aside, one or two sentences
